payload.body: WP02 amendment from hv's answers (vc, 2026-10-31): (a) question 4: a declared leg whose host pre-flight could not reach is `absent`, named at pre-flight and in the plan the confirm shows; the loop runs the legs that are present, the tag waits only for them, and the RELEASE seal records the absent leg as not run and why; `absent` is the sixth leg word (dc's WP05 produces it). (b) question 6: WSL blocks nothing, as today, and no mechanism is built for it. (c) hv set a direction the diagnosis did not have, build artefacts cached by the hash of their inputs (D67, WP16, design first); nothing in WP02 changes for it, but the RELEASE seal's per-leg lines gain nothing new either. Hold stands; take these into WP02b when the hold lifts.
